content.title: Nuburu (BURU) Announces Potential Acquisition of Tekne to Advance its Defense Technology
content.summary: On May 22, Nuburu, Inc. (NYSEAMERICAN:BURU) announced its plan to acquire Tekne S.p.A. to advance its defense-related technologies. The company noted the acquisition is anticipated to immediately enhance Nuburu, Inc.’s (NYSEAMERICAN:BURU) revenue streams to $50 million.
